items.headline: Listed questionable for Week 10 vs. Panthers on Saints' Friday report as hamstring practice window progresses
items.take: First game-status tag since the Week 3 hamstring injury - a real step toward a return, but confirm Sunday's inactives before trusting him over Kendre Miller/Kamara.

items.headline: Rushes for 2 TDs, 122 all-purpose yards on 21 touches in Thursday's 24-21 loss to Washington
items.take: Confirms the hamstring is fully behind him - locked in as New York's bell-cow back again.

items.headline: Throws for a career-high 293 yards and a 66-yard TD to Isaiah Likely before a game-sealing INT in Thursday's loss to Washington
items.take: Best statistical game of his season despite the final-play pick - trending up as a streamable low-end QB behind this Giants passing attack.

items.headline: Hauls in a 66-yard TD from J.J. McCarthy in Thursday's loss to Washington
items.take: Another explosive play for Likely in New York's passing game - firmly the Giants' top receiving threat at tight end.

items.headline: Leads the game-winning drive, hits Stefon Diggs for a 32-yard TD with 57 seconds left to beat the Giants 24-21
items.take: Clutch finish keeps Washington's passing game humming even with Terry McLaurin out for the season - a confident weekly start.

items.headline: Catches the 32-yard game-winning TD from Jayden Daniels with 57 seconds left in Thursday's 24-21 win over the Giants
items.take: The go-to red-zone/late-game target in Washington's passing game with McLaurin done for the year - trending up.

items.headline: Rapoport: could return in 2-3 weeks after finger surgery; Packers plan to avoid IR
items.take: A firmer timeline than Sunday's 'surgery needed, IR not ruled out' report - Kaleb Johnson projects as Green Bay's lead ground option in the meantime.

items.headline: Projected as Packers' lead ground option for Week 10 vs. Vikings with Josh Jacobs out
items.take: Already outsnapped Jacobs late in Week 9 after the finger injury (14 carries, 68 yards) - the clear volume play in Green Bay's backfield over Chris Brooks/Pierre Strong this week.

items.headline: O'Connell: hamstring leaves him not expected to play Sunday vs. Packers; Cousins, Wentz, Brosmer in the mix for the start
items.take: Still week-to-week with no IR move - Kirk Cousins is the presumptive Week 10 starter unless Carson Wentz (ankle) or Max Brosmer get the nod; confirm Friday's final call before trusting any Vikings passing-game piece.

items.headline: No injury designation for tonight's TNF game at Giants despite foot issue that held him out of practice
items.take: Cleared off the report after DNP/limited sessions this week - usable as a low-end flex if Washington leans on him in the short week.

items.headline: Full-go and ready for tonight's Thursday Night opener vs. Washington after Week 9 hamstring absence
items.take: Back as the Giants' lead back in the short week - locks back in as a confident RB2/FLEX start tonight.

items.headline: Fractured finger from Week 9 win over Patriots needs surgery; LaFleur won't rule out IR
items.take: Status for Sunday vs. Minnesota is uncertain - monitor Friday's report; Emanuel Wilson/MarShawn Lloyd are the handcuffs if he's out.

items.headline: Bowles: unlikely to be ready right after Tampa Bay's Week 10 bye
items.take: PCL recovery dragging past the original 6-8 week estimate - keep stashed on IR slots, don't bank on a Week 11 return.

items.headline: Still on IR with hamstring injury; Saints haven't yet opened his 21-day practice window
items.take: The original Week 9 target return has passed without him opening his window - Kamara/Kendre Miller remain the Saints backfield answer for Week 10.

items.headline: Suspected torn UCL from Sunday's loss at Seattle; expected to need season-ending surgery
items.take: Carson Beck takes over as Arizona's starter; Minshew is done for the year.

items.headline: Out for the season with a neck fracture suffered in Sunday's loss at Seattle
items.take: Drop in redraft; Arizona's WR room is thin after also dealing Marvin Harrison Jr. at the deadline.

items.headline: Elevated to Cardinals' starting QB after Gardner Minshew's season-ending elbow injury
items.take: Streamable only in deep/dynasty formats behind a shuffled offense; not a confident weekly start.

items.headline: Ruled out again for Week 10 (quad/rib); Macdonald says week-to-week, not headed to IR
items.take: Drew Lock keeps the job at least one more week; don't bank on Darnold's return soon.

items.headline: Starting again at QB1 for at least Week 10 vs. the Raiders with Darnold out
items.take: A confirmed Week 10 streaming floor for Seattle's pass catchers.

items.headline: Trending to start Sunday at Houston barring a concussion-protocol setback this week
items.take: Don't bench Watson-dependent pass-catchers yet, but confirm Thursday/Friday before locking in.

items.headline: Elbow MRI after Week 9 win over the Jets showed no major injury, per Rapoport
items.take: Strain/sprain being monitored for swelling; trending to play, but confirm Friday's report.

items.headline: Suffers hamstring setback in practice just as he neared a return; McVay: out another couple weeks
items.take: Keep him on the shelf; the Rams' TE room stays a committee.

items.headline: Elevated to Vikings' QB1 on the depth chart after Kyler Murray's hamstring injury
items.take: Took over Monday night's loss at Buffalo and now sits atop Minnesota's QB depth chart - a streamable floor play for Vikings pass-catchers (Justin Jefferson, Jordan Addison, T.J. Hockenson) until Murray's hamstring clears.

items.headline: Missed Monday night's 23-6 loss at Buffalo with a hamstring injury
items.take: Kirk Cousins took over in his absence and has since been bumped ahead of him to QB1 on the depth chart - a real QB competition now, not just a one-week absence; confirm his practice status before Week 10.

items.headline: Cardinals trade him to Texans at the deadline for 2027 2nd- and 6th-round picks
items.take: Leaves an Arizona offense where he managed just 5/13 targets for 85 yards and a TD in 4 games; lands in a crowded Houston WR room (Nico Collins, Stefon Diggs) - dynasty buy-low, not an immediate redraft target.

items.headline: Colts trade him to 49ers at the deadline for a 2027 6th-round pick
items.take: Leaves Indianapolis after 40/351/1 TD this year; joins San Francisco as depth/insurance behind Deebo Samuel and Ricky Pearsall - low-end WR4/5 value right away.

items.headline: Colts trade him to Chiefs at the deadline for 2027 4th- and 5th-round picks
items.take: Lands after weeks of trade buzz; Kansas City views him as a long-term complement to Rashee Rice and Xavier Worthy - dynasty stash, deep-league watch in redraft given the target competition.

items.headline: Trade with Cardinals officially finalized; in line to start at QB1 for Baltimore in Week 10
items.take: Ends the Joe Fagnano stopgap - a steadier veteran arm under center is a modest efficiency boost for Zay Flowers and the Ravens' pass-catchers, though Brissett himself isn't a fantasy start.

items.headline: Hit that forced him out Sunday is a hip pointer, not a head injury; limited at Monday's practice
items.take: Corrects last session's open question - Harbaugh says the team 'feels fairly good' about him playing Thursday's short week vs. Washington, but confirm Wednesday's final practice report before trusting him.

items.headline: Hamstring trending in the right direction ahead of Thursday's short week vs. Washington
items.take: No official Tuesday designation yet on the short week - Devin Singletary stays the hedge until Wednesday's practice report firms up his status.

items.headline: Placed on IR with MCL/PCL knee sprains plus turf toe, out at least 4 games
items.take: Season-altering loss for a top-5 fantasy WR; earliest return is Week 15 vs. Dallas - drop to waivers/IR slot and target the Rams' next-up WR off the wire.

items.headline: Dr. Chao flagged PCL re-injury risk on same knee pre-MRI
items.take: Chao noted this is the same knee as Nacua's 2024 PCL sprain that cost him 5 games - his instinct to expect Nacua out tracked with the team's eventual IR move.

items.headline: Ruled out and missed Week 9 vs. Eagles with hamstring
items.take: Devin Singletary handled the workload in his absence - monitor Wednesday's Week 10 report before trusting Skattebo again.

items.headline: Took hard hit, briefly left Sunday's win over Eagles before returning
items.take: Jameis Winston relieved him for a few snaps, but McCarthy finished the 19-11 win - no designation yet, watch Wednesday's practice report for a head-injury listing before Week 10.

items.headline: Ruled out with concussion vs. Panthers; Broncos have Week 10 bye
items.take: Enters protocol with a bye-week cushion behind him, so there's a reasonable shot he clears in time for Week 11 - treat as a bench/FLEX-only until cleared.

items.headline: Suffered concussion late in Sunday's loss
items.take: Rookie WR now in protocol - check Wednesday's practice report before setting Week 10 lineups.

items.headline: Hauled in 39-yard OT touchdown from Sanders in Week 9 loss to Saints
items.take: Growing rapport with Sanders gives him streamable TE1 appeal as long as Watson stays out.

items.headline: Battled in first career start, Browns fall 23-22 in OT to Saints
items.take: Hit Fannin for a go-ahead OT TD but the 2-point try to win it failed - enough arm talent to stay streamable in 2QB/deep leagues with Watson out, low weekly ceiling behind a shaky O-line.

items.headline: Browns officially name Sanders starter Sunday at Saints over Watson
items.take: First career start of the season - streamable in deep/2QB leagues, low ceiling behind a shaky Browns O-line.

items.headline: Browns sticking with Sanders at Saints even after Watson returned to practice Friday
items.take: Still officially questionable (concussion protocol) but team's plan is to sit him Week 9 - treat as out for lineup purposes.

items.headline: Ruled out Week 9 vs. Giants, third straight missed game with hamstring
items.take: No practice all week - keep him benched again; Lemon/Cooper absorb the target share.

items.headline: Ruled out Week 9 vs. Giants with hamstring, third straight absence
items.take: Non-factor again; Eagles leaning on Lemon/Cooper at WR behind Barkley-heavy gameplan.

items.headline: Good to go Week 9 vs. Giants per Garafolo despite hamstring/back scare
items.take: Full workload expected - locked-in RB1 with Smith and Wicks both out, more volume likely funnels his way.

items.headline: Doubtful for Week 9 at Eagles; Rapoport says it 'does not seem' he'll play
items.take: Did not practice all week after the bye - plan for Devin Singletary as the lead back if Skattebo sits.

items.headline: No injury designation for Week 9 at Patriots after practicing in pads
items.take: Fully cleared from the cracked ribs - back to normal usage, safe to start.

items.headline: Cardinals agree to trade Brissett to Ravens as Baltimore's QB room empties out
items.take: Schefter/AP: deal still finalizing but on track -- Brissett debuts as QB1 as soon as Week 10 MNF vs. Chargers, ending the Joe Fagnano stopgap; not a fantasy start himself, but worth monitoring for Ravens pass-catchers' efficiency once he's in.

items.headline: Placed in concussion protocol after reporting symptoms following Week 8 hit vs. Steelers
items.take: DNP Wednesday; still facing an uphill battle to clear in time for Sunday at New Orleans as of Saturday -- treat as a likely scratch, with Shedeur Sanders the Week 9 streaming/start alternative if you roster both.

items.headline: In line for first career start vs. Saints if Deshaun Watson can't clear concussion protocol
items.take: Browns' primary backup all season under Todd Monken -- a deep-league streaming option vs. a Saints defense allowing plenty through the air if Watson sits.

items.headline: Started at QB in Thursday's 33-10 loss to Jaguars with Jackson (IR) and Huntley both out
items.take: Confirms Baltimore's QB room is down to the undrafted rookie for now -- a stream-avoid for Ravens pass catchers, not a start for Fagnano himself.

items.headline: Broke a 65-yard touchdown run in Thursday's 33-10 loss to the Jaguars
items.take: Longest play of the night for Baltimore's offense -- a change-of-pace flash behind Derrick Henry, not a role change, but worth a FLEX look if Henry's workload dips.

items.headline: Hauled in a 50-yard TD from Trevor Lawrence in Jacksonville's 33-10 rout of Baltimore on TNF
items.take: Had 20 combined targets over his prior two games entering this one -- trending toward a real weekly role in the Jaguars' passing game.

items.headline: Hurt hamstring on final carry of Week 7 OT win at Houston; coach Daboll calls him day-to-day for Week 9 vs. Eagles
items.take: No firm game status yet -- watch Thursday/Friday practice reports; Devin Singletary is the handcuff if Skattebo sits.

items.headline: Played through fractured ribs (8 catches, 113 yards) in Thursday win over Panthers after X-rays showed cracked ribs
items.take: CT scan showed no internal injury; the Thursday-to-Sunday gap gives him 10 days rest before Week 9 vs. Patriots (Nov. 8) -- trending toward playing.

items.headline: Season debut vs. Bears: 9 touches (6 car, 3 rec) after Feb ACL surgery
items.take: Now Seattle's clear early-down back with Kenneth Walker in KC -- role should grow weekly; solid speculative flex add.

items.headline: Fractured tibia from Week 8 OT win at Dallas ends his season; no surgery needed
items.take: Michael Wilson is now Arizona's unquestioned WR1 target hog with Bourne and Harrison Jr. both gone.

items.headline: Rushed for 3 TDs (27 car, 69 yds) in 34-17 MNF rout of Seahawks
items.take: Bears' ground game and offense rolling behind Caleb Williams -- Swift is a weekly RB1 in this offense right now.

items.headline: Shanahan: hamstring has a chance to clear him for Week 9 vs. Raiders
items.take: First real return target since the Week 6 hamstring strain -- monitor Wed/Thu practice reports before trusting him as a start.

items.headline: Headed to IR for right thumb surgery; Rapoport says he is 'likely out for the season'
items.take: Coach Jesse Minter called the thumb injury potentially season-ending, and IR means four games at minimum either way. With Huntley (turf toe) also out, Baltimore is down to Slovis / Fagnano.

items.headline: Turf toe from Week 8 expected to cost him extended time; out for Week 9 vs. Jaguars
items.take: Ravens signed Kedon Slovis off Green Bay's practice squad; 'extended time' read as 3-6 weeks.

items.headline: Has no injury designation for Week 8 vs. Commanders after hamstring/back scare
items.take: Cleared without a tag for SNF; expected full workload, though usage may still be managed early

items.headline: Back to full practice, expected to play Week 8 vs. Titans despite ankle bruise
items.take: Rapoport says the ankle isn't believed serious; no reason to fade him in lineups

items.headline: Returned to practice and cleared to play Week 8 vs. Broncos after hamstring absence
items.take: First game back since the Week 4 hamstring injury; target share likely ramps up gradually

items.headline: Removed from injury report, no ankle concern entering Week 8 vs. Vikings
items.take: Full-strength lead target for Detroit's passing game this week

items.headline: Trade market widens as Chiefs, Steelers, Seahawks, Patriots call Colts on him
items.take: Selling Colts (already dealt Nelson, Buckner) look likely to move him before the Nov. 10 deadline; redraft value hinges on landing spot

items.headline: Inactive for Week 8 vs. Dolphins with a knee issue
items.take: Patriots' top WR sits again; expect more targets for Kayshon Boutte and Mack Hollins Sunday

items.headline: Inactive for Week 8 vs. Dolphins with an illness
items.take: Clears the way for Rhamondre Stevenson to handle the Patriots' backfield workload Sunday

items.headline: Ruled out for Week 8 vs. Falcons with concussion/foot, per Bowles
items.take: Second straight missed game; more Tampa Bay targets funnel to Mike Evans and Chris Godwin

items.headline: Listed questionable for Week 8 vs. Raiders with lingering quad injury
items.take: Same quad issue that cost him Week 6; confirm inactives before trusting him as a starter

items.headline: Regained lead role with 42-yard run in OT win at Houston; Giants on bye Week 8
items.take: Snap count climbed back up after a near-benching in Week 6; buy-low ahead of Giants' return from bye

items.headline: Requests trade out of Indianapolis ahead of Nov. 10 deadline
items.take: No deal done yet, but Chiefs/Steelers are named suitors -- watch for a landing-spot shakeup to WR rooms on both sides if he's dealt

items.headline: Top Week 8 waiver add after back-to-back weeks of 5+ targets and a TD
items.take: Trending toward weekly streaming/flex value in the Jets' offense; still only ~35% rostered

items.headline: Full practice all week, no injury designation; set to start Sunday vs. Bills
items.take: Three-game ankle absence is over -- back in as a weekly low-end QB1, Huntley reverts to backup.

items.headline: Dealing with a back issue; Friday status unclear ahead of SNF vs. Commanders
items.take: Eagles are already without Bigsby and Shipley (both IR) -- a Barkley absence would push early-down work to Elijah Mitchell.

items.headline: Officially questionable for Week 8 vs. Lions after aggravating his MCL vs. Colts
items.take: He played through the same sprained MCL since Week 2 and tweaked it again Sunday; treat as a true game-time call, with Jordan Mason the handcuff if he sits.

items.headline: Led Broncos RBs with 49% snap share in Week 7 return, reignites Week 8 waiver buzz
items.take: Rookie out-touched RJ Harvey and J.K. Dobbins (9 carries/2 catches) in his first game back; Dobbins kept the goal-line work but Coleman looks like the early-down lead if the split holds -- priority Week 8 add.

items.headline: DNP Wednesday with 'rest/ankle' tag; Bengals not worried about Sunday
items.take: Trending toward playing Week 8 vs. Titans; Higgins would benefit if he sits.

items.headline: DNP Wednesday with shoulder injury ahead of Week 8 vs. Vikings
items.take: Monitor Thursday's report; Sione Vaki is next up if Gibbs can't go.

items.headline: Set to practice Wednesday as hamstring recovery continues
items.take: First real step back since the Week 4 hamstring injury; trending toward a Week 8 return vs. Broncos.

items.headline: Practicing Wednesday on ankle; Hensley says only Jackson knows when he's back
items.take: Good sign for Week 8 vs. Bills, but the lingering ankle keeps him a game-time-decision risk.

items.headline: Limited in Wednesday practice with groin injury
items.take: Positive step after missing Week 7; Colts need him back as their top red-zone target.

items.headline: Will practice Wednesday after missing time with hamstring injury
items.take: Rookie has a real shot to play Week 8 vs. Rams; speculative add if he's cleared Friday.

items.headline: Packers list him questionable for Week 8 vs. Panthers (shoulder/foot)
items.take: True game-time decision; have a contingency plan ready in lineups.

items.headline: Broncos unsure about Waddle's Week 8 availability
items.take: Chest/rib issue lingering; check Thursday-Friday reports before trusting him vs. Chiefs.

items.headline: Says he has not requested a trade out of New York
items.take: Removes trade-deadline uncertainty for now; stays the clear WR1 in the Jets' offense.

items.headline: Chiefs sign Justin Tucker to practice squad after Butker misses two kicks
items.take: Not an immediate change, but a shot across the bow — watch Butker's role if the misses continue.

items.headline: Diagnosed with turf toe after Week 7 exit; in walking boot, not on IR
items.take: Texans' Week 8 bye buys him recovery time; next game is Nov. 8 at the Chargers.

items.headline: Throws for 212 yards, 3 TDs (2 to Lamb), no INTs in 38-21 MNF rout of Eagles
items.take: Clean, efficient outing against a depleted Eagles D -- trending up for fantasy

items.headline: Catches 2 TDs from Dak Prescott in 38-21 MNF win over Eagles
items.take: Back to form as Dallas's top target in a blowout win

items.headline: Officially questionable for MNF vs. Cowboys after full practice Saturday (hamstring)
items.take: Trending toward playing after a full Saturday practice, but it is a true game-time call for Week 7.

items.headline: Expected to play Monday night vs. Eagles after practicing fully Friday and Saturday
items.take: No injury concern for Dallas's top receiver in the Week 7 finale.

items.headline: Ruled out for Monday night vs. Eagles with a ribs injury
items.take: Removes a return/gadget touch option from Dallas's offense for the MNF finale.

items.headline: Ruled out for Monday night vs. Cowboys with an ankle injury
items.take: Minor given his limited role, but trims an already-thin Eagles WR room further behind A.J. Brown.

items.headline: Ruled out for Week 7 vs. Cowboys (Monday night) with a recurrence of his hamstring/toe issue
items.take: Smith sits again after playing through it in Week 6 -- more targets funnel to A.J. Brown and a hamstring-recovering Saquon Barkley in Philly's Monday-night offense.

items.headline: Comes off the injury report and is active for Week 7 vs. Panthers
items.take: Irving is clear to go alongside a returning Mayfield -- full workload expected in the Bucs backfield.

items.headline: Active and starts Week 7 vs. Panthers after missing 3 weeks with dislocated thumb
items.take: Mayfield reclaims the Bucs' starting job from Jalon Daniels -- bump Tampa Bay's pass-catchers (Egbuka, Evans-type volume) back up after a three-week dip.

items.headline: Ruled out for Week 7 vs. Bengals with ankle injury
items.take: Tyler Huntley starts at QB for Baltimore Sunday; fade Ravens pass-catchers, downgrade the offense overall

items.headline: Tore patellar tendon in MNF loss to 49ers, out for the season per Schefter
items.take: Correction: an earlier scan reported McLaurin played Monday night with no designation; he was actually carted off in the first quarter and is done for 2026 — treat Washington's WR room as missing its WR1 rest of season

items.headline: Placed on IR with season-ending knee injury suffered vs. Patriots
items.take: Done for 2026 — Colston Loveland becomes the clear TE1 in Chicago's passing game, with rookie Sam Roush the No. 2.

items.headline: Set to take over as Bears' lead TE after Cole Kmet's season-ending injury
items.take: Immediate streaming/waiver add at TE with Kmet on IR for the rest of the year.

items.headline: Downgraded to DNP Friday, doubtful for Week 7 at Houston with neck injury
items.take: Trending toward a second straight missed game — plan for a replacement TE vs. the Texans.

items.headline: Ruled out for Week 7 vs. Seahawks with hamstring injury
items.take: Second straight week out — Jalen Royals and Xavier Worthy stay the top beneficiaries in Kansas City's passing game.

items.headline: Listed out for Week 7 vs. Seahawks with hamstring injury
items.take: Out of the Chiefs' backfield mix this week; monitor Friday inactives for confirmation.

items.headline: Officially questionable for Sunday vs. Bengals after a third straight limited practice
items.take: Real game-time decision on the ankle — have a Cooper Rush/Josh Johnson contingency ready if you stream Ravens pieces.

items.headline: Listed questionable for Week 7 vs. Panthers after clearing thumb to practice
items.take: No clean start/sit call yet — if he's out, Jalon Daniels starts a fourth straight game.

items.headline: Ruled out for Week 7 vs. Panthers with concussion/foot injury
items.take: Out again — expanded target share for whoever starts at QB to throw to among Tampa Bay's remaining WRs.

items.headline: Off the injury report for Week 7 vs. Steelers in Paris
items.take: Trending toward a full workload after a back issue limited him in practice; locks back in as a top-24 RB play.

items.headline: Ruptured hamstring in Week 6 loss to Cardinals; McVay says he's out 6-10 weeks after surgery
items.take: ESPN's Jeremy Fowler reports Dr. Neal ElAttrache performed the repair -- Adams is off redraft rosters for at least six weeks, with Puka Nacua absorbing an even bigger target share

items.headline: Tore ACL in Week 6 loss to Cardinals, out for the rest of the season
items.take: Rams need a new placekicker -- streaming-only note for kicker-stream leagues

items.headline: Diagnosed with DVT and blood clots in both lungs; ESPN, NFL Network report he's likely out for the season
items.take: Tanner McKee is now Philadelphia's QB for the foreseeable future -- treat Hurts as off fantasy boards; this escalates well past the "superficial clot" news from Thursday

items.headline: AP: dislocated ankle and torn ligaments will require surgery, expected out 12-16 weeks
items.take: Effectively a lost season for Thornton with only an outside shot at a late-season/playoff return -- opens up extra snaps in KC's thin WR room for the rest of the year.

items.headline: Core-muscle surgery set at the Vincera Institute; Eagles hopeful for a six-week-or-sooner return
items.take: First real runway on his IR stint -- Will Shipley stays the clear lead Eagles back in the meantime; Bigsby's a Week 11-12 stash at best.

items.headline: Rapoport: fractured, dislocated ankle in London; likely out for the season
items.take: Marginal fantasy piece as a returner/WR4, but another blow to a banged-up Washington receiver room.

items.headline: Out for the rest of the 2026 season; will undergo neck surgery
items.take: Season-ending neck surgery -- Christian Watson and Matthew Golden absorb his target share in Green Bay's passing game.

items.headline: Officially placed on IR with a PCL sprain, expected out 6-8 weeks
items.take: Ends any near-term bounce-back hope -- Egbuka and Godwin absorb his target share for at least a month and a half.

items.headline: Confirmed torn ACL in right knee; out for the rest of the 2026 season
items.take: Season is over -- Ollie Gordon II is now the clear early-down back in Miami's backfield.

items.headline: Officially out for rest of regular season; surgery for MCL/PCL/meniscus damage
items.take: Season is over — bench in all formats; Jameis Winston is the full-time starter
